investigation_root_causes.scraper_failure_root_cause: In D-11.4, SourceScraper incorrectly checked 'cloudflare in lower_html'. Legitimate news websites such as See Hua Daily and Sin Chew Daily load legitimate CDN scripts from cdnjs.cloudflare.com and cloudflare-static plugins, causing genuine HTTP 200 pages with full article text to be falsely rejected as ACCESS_BLOCKED_OR_CHALLENGE (42 out of 45). Furthermore, Google News redirect URLs were fetched directly without unwrapping the batchexecute RPC.
investigation_root_causes.corroboration_failure_root_cause: In D-11.4, ArticleDeduplicator matched generic numbers > 5 ('NUM:10', 'NUM:15') and generic words ('air' = water in Malay, which appeared in 'tanah air' for homeland). Any article with LOC:SABAH and NUM:10 or 'air' was merged. Transitive single-linkage chaining (any(is_same_event)) chained 247 articles into a single mega-cluster led by an unrelated international story ('No water to cook or bathe...'). When that cluster was penalized (-300) and discarded, all 54 corroborating sources were wiped out, leaving only isolated single-source items in the Top-10.

editorial_top_10.body_excerpt:
（亚庇9日讯）沙巴多个地区预计将持续降雨至本周三（11日），大马气象局已发布警戒级持续降雨警报，提醒民众提高警惕。

大马气象局今日发布声明指出，受影响地区包括古达，以及山打根、京那巴当岸、拜丹、特鲁必和拉卜部分地区。

气象局促请受影响地区民众保持警惕，采取必要的防范措施，以应对持续降雨可能带来的影响。

editorial_top_10.body_excerpt:
（山打根8日讯）「第16届（2026年）婆罗洲观鸟节」经于上周六及周日（本月7日至8日）在沙巴森林局属下森林研究中心（FRC）位于沙巴山打根西必洛路14哩的森林探索中心（RDC）圆满举行，吸引来自国内外数以千计的观鸟爱好者、摄影师、学生及家庭踊跃参加。

据披露，今年活动一大亮点是「观鸟竞赛」，共吸引约45支队伍参赛，创下2009年首办以来最高纪录。参赛者来自我国马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡、越南和纽西兰，以及中国大陆和台湾，展现观鸟活动跨越国界的凝聚力。
